name: Saalim Aqueel
description: **Saalim Aqueel** is an open-source developer and MSc AI & ML student at Jamia Millia Islamia. He is a **Google Summer of Code 2026 contributor with FOSSASIA**, working primarily across the Eventyay ecosystem. His work includes building the **Eventyay Social Media Plugin** for automating event promotion, contributing to the Eventyay platform, and collaborating on **VEditor**, an open-source video processing and review system for conference recordings. His interests span **backend engineering, developer tooling, GenAI/ML, and open-source software**. He enjoys working on practical systems that integrate into existing platforms and turn complex workflows into reliable, reusable tools.
